id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|67af: "Sylvando entering really saved me. And so fast, too! I wish he'd just become a knight.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|67be: "I hear the entertainer Sylvando is leaving this kingdom. I never got to see his show. How disappointing.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|683b: "Wow, Sylvando isn't just good at acts, he's that good with horses! A famous star really is different.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6849: "Sylvando even mastered swordplay... He can do anything! Sylvando is truly worthy of being a star!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68a1: "The Faris Cup was a huge success! A historic race that will be told for ages!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68ae: "Now, we circus members are diligently preparing the next show! People of Gallopolis, look forward to it!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68bf: "Welcome~! The circus is romance! Come at night if you want to see a new show!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6966: "Up here, everyone passing through town is talking about the Faris Cup! How amazing the prince and Sylvando were!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6977: "Hey, hey! Prince Faris is going to capture a giant scorpion called the desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6982: "Even strong knights can't beat it, so can the prince capture it...?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|698f: "Hey, hey! To celebrate Sylvando beating the desert killer, you can watch the circus for free now!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|699b: "If it's free, I might climb down and go see it... I can't decide.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b38: "The Faris Cup had a huge crowd... I got swept along by the unfamiliar crowd and missed the race itself.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b45: "That upset her again. Nothing has gone right since we came to this country. It's one thing after another. Sigh...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b57: "The prince who ran the Faris Cup wasn't really the prince, and the one who captured the desert killer wasn't either...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b65: "It's so complicated I can't keep up. I apologized out of habit and she got mad again... One thing after another. Sigh...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b76: "Finally this feels like a trip. She seems to like the circus, so the trouble of getting these seats paid off.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bed: "He's so clumsy! He got swept along by the crowd and missed Prince Faris's race! Unbelievable!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bfb: "Compared to this clumsy guy, the prince's ride was gallant! I wish my boyfriend were the prince!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c0c: "The prince is handsome, but he had a double run the Faris Cup, so he's a bit of a liar...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c17: "Thinking about it, even this boyfriend is lovely in his honesty... but I wish he'd stop always apologizing.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c27: "My boyfriend splurged on these rich circus seats! Watching the show seated is lovely!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c31: "It finally feels like a trip, and I've warmed to my boyfriend a little!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6caf: "Amid the fierce race... the mysterious entertainer Sylvando crashes in~!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6cb9: "Go, Sylvando, so fast! He overtakes Sharukh in an instant and already leads alone! Like the wind~!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ccc: "A mysterious man suddenly crashed in and now it's getting really fun! This will be a heated race! No doubt!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d11: "The race is finally in its final stretch! ...And here comes a furious chase from our own Prince Faris!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d1b: "Oh, the prince leaps to the front at last! I'm amazed he's this fast! The win is near! Go, become the wind!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d41: "How do they do such amazing things?! If we practice, could we do it too?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ec1: "N-no, it's not like that! It's a conspiracy! A trap to ruin me, who devised the winning method! I never lied!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ecd: "Faiz was fated to win. But my method hit so well that the country saw me as a danger and framed me!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ee2: "A national conspiracy ruined last time, but my method makes race predictions hit every time! Many got rich!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ef6: "Learn the method I devised after years of research and the next race prediction is sure to hit! Come, hear me out!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f42: "Listen to me. I paid this man 10,000 gold for his so-called winning method.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f4b: "The method was that Faiz would win... but he didn't even enter the race!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f55: "It's just awful. Once I get my money back, I'll dump this man in the middle of the desert!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f66: "Listen to me. He missed big, yet never tires of peddling his race winning method.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f73: "Being this persistent, I respect his guts. Maybe I'll believe him one more time...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fc8: "I knew it, but even after the Faris Cup he only talks about horses! I'm so fed up!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fd2: "Still, the prince was cool, even in a helmet. I wish my husband were like that...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fe1: "My husband worries whether the prince can really capture the desert killer, but I don't!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ff0: "That cool prince will surely beat the desert killer to a pulp!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fff: "Now that the desert killer's beaten, he acts like nothing happened and just talks about horses...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|700c: "Well, it's a sign of peace too. Maybe I'll actually listen to his horse talk once in a while.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|701c: "I left my horse-obsessed husband behind and came to the circus alone! This is nice once in a while!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70e7: "The Faris Cup was a heated race! As far as I know, the most exciting one in years!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70f5: "Especially Prince Faris, called the finest prince since the founding, showed a dignified ride as rumored!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|712e: "Shocking that the rumor of the prince's brilliance was a huge misunderstanding. Nobody noticed!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|714f: "Shocking that the rumor of the prince's brilliance was a huge misunderstanding. Nobody noticed!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|713b: "But facing the desert killer, he was brave. I look forward to his growth!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|715c: "But facing the desert killer, he was brave. I look forward to his growth!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7201: "Prince Faris's ride was unique. He felt noble as royalty, yet in a good way, not very Gallopolis-like...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7210: "Well, anyway, if the prince is like that, the country will be safe forever. A true heir. Ho ho ho.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7221: "I hear the prince cheated in many ways. Now that you say so, the prince in the Faris Cup didn't seem like Prince Faris.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|722e: "Well, he's still young. If he reflects on this and grows, the country will be safe. Ho ho ho.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7240: "Hey, youngster! Stop wandering and watch quietly! You're bothering the other spectators!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|727c: "Oh, how terrible... The desert killer has finally appeared, I hear. It comes every year at this time.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7289: "Its claws are strong enough to smash armor. If you value your life, stay away from the Celestial Sands.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7299: "The desert killer's threat is gone, what a relief. ...But we mustn't forget the knights' noble sacrifices behind it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72a9: "...O gods. For the knights who lost and turned to sand, please grant the rain of salvation...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7310: "The Faris Cup was wonderful. I couldn't believe my eyes when the entertainer Sylvando entered without notice!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7322: "Oh dear, what I feared has happened... The desert killer Deathscorpion has appeared at the Celestial Sands again this year.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|732f: "It's an old story, but a knight friend of mine was killed by it. I hope no one is lost this time...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7342: "Oh! You captured the desert killer, I heard!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|734b: "Now my knight friend, killed by the desert killer, can rest in peace. Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|735e: "Watching the circus like this, I truly feel the peace! It's all thanks to you!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7399: "Well, as rumored, Prince Faris's ride was splendid! It was worth coming from a faraway country.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73a5: "His helmet hid his face in the race, but he came to the paddock after. Indeed a refreshing handsome man.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73b7: "The rumor that the prince is strong and sturdy was a total lie... As someone who likes the strong, that's a pity.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73c4: "But the prince facing the scorpion monster was brave and, above all, cool.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73ce: "The rumor that he's the most refreshingly handsome in history was true. Coming from a faraway country was worth it. Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|746c: "The Faris Cup just ended and races already resume. This country's love of racing is bottomless.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|747c: "I'll win the race this time! I feel it will surely hit next time!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7529: "The Faris Cup ended in a frenzy, but other races run as usual.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7542: "If you want to enter a race, apply at the reception inside.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75b6: "Did you see the prince's ride! That was the ride of a future racing champion!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75c1: "I've watched races all my life, so my eye can't be wrong.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75db: "He'll surely throw the guts he showed in the Faris Cup at that scorpion monster! I can picture the prince returning proudly!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75ee: "I know races well! The traveler who ran in the prince's place... I thought he was the real thing!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75fb: "I've watched races all my life. I sensed talent to become a champion someday.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76da: "Wow, the entertainer Sylvando in the Faris Cup was great.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76e2: "Yes, he rode an incredible horse. Prince Faris's horse wasn't bad, but the entertainer's was in another class.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76f2: "The prince who ran well in the Faris Cup is going to capture that desert killer! This is big news!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7700: "...But bravery is fine and all, it's a foe that has tormented veteran knights, right? This time I'm worried...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7712: "Hey, look at that horse's hooves. For horse lovers, irresistible. I'd love to be trampled by those hooves.

tm.「お前たちは 今に 砂漠の殺し屋などとは\n 比べものにならない 真の恐怖を味わ: "You will soon taste true terror, far beyond a mere desert killer. Remember my prophecy well...

tm.「ファーリス王子さまが\n 砂漠の殺し屋をねえ……。: "Prince Faris against the desert killer, hm...

tm.「いろいろ あったが レースも再開！\n この場所も また にぎやかになりそうだ: "A lot happened, but racing is back! This place will be lively again.
tm.「この先は レース場の観客席だ。\n もし レースへ出場したいのならば\n パド: "Beyond here are the racetrack stands. If you want to race, go north through the paddock to the reception.
tm.「むむっ キサマ……\n この前 ファーリス杯の時\n レース場で 見た気がする: "Hmm! You... I think I saw you at the racetrack during the Faris Cup.
tm.「ハっ まさか！ キサマ レースに……: "Whoa, no way! You entered the race...
tm.「出てるワケないか。ハハハ 気のせいだ！\n よしっ 異常なしーっ！: "Can't be. Ha ha, my imagination! All clear!
tm.「ファーリス杯が終わって\n ますます サマディーは 平和だ！\n 異常なしーっ: "With the Faris Cup over, Gallopolis is even more peaceful! All clear!
tm.「王子さまのファンのコたちが\n 見送りのために 町の入り口の方へ\n 行ってい: "The prince's fans went toward the town entrance to see him off.
tm.「夜は いつもなら あのコたちを\n 追い返してる時間なんだけど ヒマだな。\n: "This is when I usually chase them off at night, but now I'm idle. Both happy and a bit lonely...
tm.「おかげさまで サマディーは\n 本日も 平和でありますっ！\n 異常なーし！: "Thanks to you, Gallopolis is peaceful again today! All clear!
tm.「ファーリスさまが ヘッポコだって知ったのに\n このコたち ファンをやめないそ: "They learned Prince Faris is a dud, but these kids still haven't quit being fans.
tm.「まあ このコたちが来てくれて おかげで\n 夜のさびしさも まぎれて 助かって: "Well, their visits ease my loneliness at night, so it helps. Annoying and welcome at once...
tm.「しかし こうして 毎晩 会ってるんだから\n そろそろ この俺の魅力に\n 気: "Seeing each other every night, they could notice my charm by now...
tm.「オグイは さぞ無念だろうな。\n ファーリス杯に 出られなかったうえに\n 代: "Faiz must be so bitter. Couldn't enter the Faris Cup, and a mysterious entertainer in his place did great.
tm.「砂漠の殺し屋が現れて\n ついに このウマたちの出番かと思ったが\n 結局 出: "The desert killer appeared and I thought the horses' time had finally come, but we never deployed...
tm.「ま 平和が いちばんだからな。\n 兵馬たちの出番がないに 越したことはないな: "Well, peace is best. It's good when the war horses' turn never comes.
tm.「ファーリス王子さまは すごいと評判だったけど\n たしかに いい走りを見せてい: "They said Prince Faris was amazing, and he did show a fine run. As expected of the prince of the land of knights.
tm.「王国の騎士たちでも\n キズひとつ つけることができないという\n あの 砂漠: "Even the kingdom's knights couldn't scratch the desert killer, and that's the opponent.
tm.「皆が 心配するのもわかるけど\n あのレースの走りっぷりを見るに\n 王子さま: "I understand everyone's worry, but judging by that race, I think the prince can surely do it.
tm.「なんでも シルビアが\n この国から 離れてしまうようなんだ。: "I hear Sylvando is leaving this country.
tm.「あんなに 面白いショーができて\n しかも 砂漠の殺し屋を倒すほど 強いときた: "He puts on such fun shows and is strong enough to beat the desert killer. He'll be popular in other countries too.
tm.「ファーリス杯 楽しかったですわ！\n あんなに 楽しいレースでしたら\n 毎年: "The Faris Cup was fun! Such fun races, I'd love to see them every year.
tm.「まあ あなた\n 砂漠の殺し屋の件 ご覧になりまして？: "Oh my, did you see the desert killer incident?
tm.「あの 勇敢な王子さまの戦いぶり。\n さっそうと現れ 魔物を一閃した シルビア: "The brave prince's fight. Sylvando dashing in to slash the monster. So rarely amazing!
tm.「オグイが欠場して あわてていたところに\n 突然 シルビアさんが現れて\n 代: "I was panicking when Faiz dropped out, and suddenly Sylvando appeared and agreed to enter in his place.
tm.「シルビアさんが出てくれて 本当に助かったよ。\n おまけに あんなに速いだなん: "Sylvando entering really saved me. And so fast, too! I wish he'd just become a knight.
tm.「なんでも 旅芸人のシルビアが\n この王国を 離れるんだそうな。\n 結局 シ: "I hear the entertainer Sylvando is leaving this kingdom. I never got to see his show. How disappointing.
tm.「いやあ～ シルビアは芸だけでなくて\n ウマの扱いも あそこまでウマいとは！\: "Wow, Sylvando isn't just good at acts, he's that good with horses! A famous star really is different.
tm.「シルビア 剣技までマスターしてるなんて……\n 本当に 何でもこなせちゃうヤツ: "Sylvando even mastered swordplay... He can do anything! Sylvando is truly worthy of being a star!
tm.「ファーリス杯は 大盛況！\n 長く後世まで 語り継がれるような\n 歴史的な: "The Faris Cup was a huge success! A historic race that will be told for ages!
tm.「さーて 私たち サーカス団も\n 次回の公演に向け 鋭意 準備中よ！\n サマ: "Now, we circus members are diligently preparing the next show! People of Gallopolis, look forward to it!

tm.「ここにいると 行きかう町の人たち\n みーんな ファーリス杯の話をしてるわ！\: "Up here, everyone passing through town is talking about the Faris Cup! How amazing the prince and Sylvando were!
